name: Sudan
shortSummary: India's relationship with Sudan has been overshadowed by the civil war that erupted in April 2023 between rival military factions; India conducted a large evacuation of its nationals (Operation Kaveri) that year.

majorChallenges.title: 2023 civil war
majorChallenges.description: Ongoing conflict between Sudanese military factions has disrupted diplomatic and economic engagement.
